gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-mooli: Balsamiq Sans draws everything with one constant pen width, no pinching anywhere. Mooli, a plain sans with open round letters, keeps a long page of text easy on the eye and quietly out of the way.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-murecho: Murecho is a clean sans whose s curves open wide at both ends, giving text a relaxed look. Murecho against the pen-steady, unthinning curves of Balsamiq Sans is where this pairing is strongest.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-nanum-gothic: Chunky, hand-drawn confidence up top from Balsamiq Sans, with no downstroke ever getting heavier. And Nanum Gothic, a plain sans with wide channels into each counter, fills in the text beneath with tidy, open shapes.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-niramit: Balsamiq Sans holds its stroke like a stylus at fixed pressure, so every line looks uniformly inked. Niramit, a sans with gaping curves, gives the text below a wider, lighter texture that sets off that heavy marker feel.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-canadi: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal is a plain sans with openness at every curve end, and it feels light on the page. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal sets that against the round, never-swelling bowls of Balsamiq Sans, and the difference is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-cypro-: Noto Sans Cypro Minoan cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap, which gives text a spacious, contemporary look. But Balsamiq Sans answers with n arches as thick as the stems beside them, a solid, stencil-like heading.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-hanifi: Approachable is the first word for Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya, with its visibly gaping c, against tubular Balsamiq Sans headings like bent copper pipe. Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya, a sans-serif, keeps paragraphs friendly and open from the first line to the last.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Noto Sans Hatran reads friendly, with a wide funnel-like throat in the e. Over many paragraphs it stays light and easy, a sans that lets Balsamiq Sans carry the stems-without-hairlines punch above.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Balsamiq Sans sets a rhythm of identical bar thickness across every line, which is its signature. And Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi, a plain sans with an unclogged feel in each small counter, gives that rhythm a lighter, easier follow-up.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-javane: Balsamiq Sans holds its stroke weight like a stylus at fixed pressure, loud and round at the top of the page. Noto Sans Javanese, a sans-serif with connected apertures, softens things below.
